subject: TargetRWE Pros and Cons of Encord
text:
Hi Alex and Team at Encord,

Here are the pros and cons the team came up with during our trial:

PROs

CONs

Data Types: PDF, Text, Audio, Video

Can not create visual line for relations on a PDF, but can with text - need to use dropdown for relationships on PDFs

Audit Preparedness: full traceability and audit-ability for Regulatory

Can't relate things to what's collected in the dropdowns

Search through all PDF Feature

Color coding needs to be improved - currently causing confusion

Orchestration of Data Pipeline through creation of a visual system to define tasks, and push data through workflows and people or groups

Can not do command find on entire document, is only on page by page level and is picking up words from the annotator instructions

Good at scale

Hard to decipher relationships

Label from Scratch or based off of model results

Have to go through all annotations before rejecting/approving a note level

Can make as many relations as needed

No way to approve or reject relationships, need to reject the actual item (form, dose, amount etc.)

Reporting on productivity and project progress

• 
abstractor dashboard of their own progress on work

• 
admin view into abstractor progress

No ability to track Note ID after submitting it - for history or to go back and edit

• 
Abstractors cannot track their history

• 
Each task or text isn’t assigned a sequence of numbers, unsure how to keep track of a task if you need to go back to edit something
 / no back button to go back and edit

• 
Reviewers also want to see the Note IDs so they can note it down if they have a question

Easy definition and entry of values within the UI, and still allows for comment on that if needed

Don’t prefer using a drop down to make the relationship vs. the ease of clicking attribute and hotkey R as with other annotation platforms

Ability to annotate and click quick to go to that spot on the note is great

Can do manual abstraction on the platform through the creation of form f

text:
Hi,

I wanted to send over some new bugs I found from using the Active embedding feature. There are two bugs that may be related.

When I have a collection being shown in an embedding and select a region to remove from that collection, the whole collection (or a larger subset than described in the bottom selection bar) is deleted. I had a 5k+ collection, tried selecting 12 images to remove from the collection when using the embedding visualizer, and my whole collection got deleted. I couldn't find an undo button in the UI or by searching the docs. I had sorted these down from 56k images so this was a pretty inconvenient bug to discover today.

I tried simulating the error by creating a debugging collection and was able to get a similar error to occur as seen in the videos attached. This collection deletes to 22 images from 186 even though I only select a few of the images from the embedding map. When I try to delete more from the 22, there are no collections to delete from (second bug).

Best,

text:
Hi Kevin,

We’re looking to move fast on this, so please line up your team accordingly. I’ll be out of office for the next two weeks, but I’ve already sent a kickoff meeting invite to get things started.
Our immediate goal is to deploy and install your product on our on-prem, air-gapped LabNet server. The software must be containerized (Dockerized).
As part of our standard process, we’ll conduct an initial CVE scan—there should be no critical or high vulnerabilities. If any are present, we’ll need a documented rationale, as these will be tracked in our risk management system.
Our team will lead the installation, but we’ll need your support—starting with a working session, followed by ongoing email support as needed. Once installation is complete, our team will take over the model training pipeline.

During the kickoff, I’ll walk through the use case, outline the requirements, and set the cadence for the evaluation.

Regards
Tripti

doesn't depend on the task. so if we calculate the monthly price for the
monthly price from you and the other provider here is the comparison:
Yearly Platform Fee Monthly Platform Fee Hourly price Number of hours per
